sourceInputs.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / PBR material reconstruction. Image 1 is the selected jar reference; image 2 is a close crop of its EXACT required clay surface. Produce ONE square seamless flat unlit material/albedo texture that closely reproduces this particular reference surface, not a generic brown ceramic. Preserve the reference's coarse eroded construction: broad irregular charcoal/slate-grey fired-clay islands, dull warm grey-brown clay, pale ochre clay grains and abrasion flakes, shallow scuffed chips and uneven horizontal wiping scratches. The grey-black patches must occupy a substantial irregular part of the surface, with light tan worn high points over them; strong local tonal variation like image 2. A crumbly stratified old earthen surface, with pits and scraped flakes about 0.5–2 mm and short abrasion marks 2–8 mm when the texture represents a 15 cm square. It is NOT homogeneous fine sand/noise, not smooth pottery, not rust, wood, leather, decorative craquelure or masonry. Match the grey/ochre/charcoal color balance and chunky surface detail of the supplied crop very closely. Flatten the curved surface and remove overall form lighting, cast shadows and highlights. Fill the whole image edge-to-edge with only the ceramic surface; NO jar silhouette, rim, cartridges, background, labels, text, border or watermark. Do not invent different decorative motifs. The result is a texture scan of the exact reference material.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: seamless square PBR BASE COLOR material scan, flat and evenly lit. A worn drawn brass rifle cartridge CASE surface, inert empty brass metal material only: muted brownish brass, soft dark grey-brown tarnish islands, fine smooth longitudinal machining/drawing traces running vertically, tiny restrained handling scratches, slight old firing discoloration. Photorealistic subtle metal patina of handled 1930s brass, no shiny yellow gold glamour. The surface is SMOOTH drawn metal with microscopic wear, not hammered, not rippled foil, not wood grain, not wrinkled leather, not rusty iron, no green corrosion. Show only the continuous flat material filling the entire square edge-to-edge. No actual cartridge silhouette, no projectile, no case openings, no object, no text, no headstamps, no labels, no watermark. Neutral diffuse illumination with NO strong highlights, no cast shadows, no vignette and no directional lighting gradients baked into the color. Seamless tileable edges. Fine texture should be much subtler than large blotches; realistic low saturation warm brass brown with a few irregular darker oxide patches.
